reviews.finding: The full pencil relation requires a held pencil, point-to-sheet contact and continuing graphite trace. The authored hand only touches a white photographic margin. Introducing writing competes with the raised-gaze comparison and is a new activity rather than a clarification; source whole adoption is not qualified. Keep the existing supported fingertip contact.

Temple touch is a compatible optional right-hand variation, realized in ALT_TEMPLE. It can suggest concentration but puts another hand near the referenced face and weakens the clean face-to-window line; baseline wins on subject presence and hierarchy. It does not prove stress or headache.

The visible heel/raised forefoot support variant would require a wider lower-body framing to verify principal support. It contributes no evidence about the photographic record or courtyard and reduces the pixel budget for their boundaries; no distinct useful local realization in this frame.

Hands acting on the visible table are already realized by the dossier contact, connected forearm and other hand beside the cover. The candidate offers no distinct change beyond the baseline clauses; ordinary overlap is not new-source adoption.

The over-the-shoulder process viewpoint is a compatible generic camera alternative developed as ALT_OTS. It makes the contact sheet larger but turns the supplied face away and makes the separate actual courtyard a smaller diagonal sliver; baseline better balances all three owners.

The full bracing-palm source requires palm beside/behind pelvis, continuous shoulder/elbow chain and visible remaining seated-leg base. That is a distinct support mechanism irrelevant to the tabletop task and would compete with both hands at the file; partial reuse as a generic seated pose would erase its meaning.

Single-leg principal support requires a planted leg and differentiated free-leg role. The authored state is seated with table support. A standing rewrite is possible only as a materially different staging with no local benefit to the record/current-space comparison; do not infer the specified leg support from a torso crop.

Artificial fingertips touching both grooves of an open lock require explicit adulthood, artificial-hand anatomy and a different target. Those facts are absent and the owner/appearance/reference boundary cannot be supplied by discovery. Reject whole source; do not turn ordinary fingertips into prosthetic lock-working anatomy.

The Snell-window source requires underwater capture, a transmitted above-water region and surrounding reflected underwater regions. A room window is not that optical relation. Realizing it would replace the physical setting and medium relation rather than locally refine this records-room frame; source is not a generic window synonym.

A physical foreground boundary enclosing the subject can be developed as generic ALT_FRAME, but it spends three frame sides on a nearer doorway and reduces the already demanding paper/window legibility. Baseline keeps the subject adjacent to the actual window without an enclosing foreground apparatus.

The complete visual profile requires a scene-bound foreground opening enclosing the primary subject on at least three sides with near-plane thickness and legible subject. ALT_FRAME examines that complete geometry; native profile is not selected and its opt-in evidence/gates are not promoted. Baseline favors larger paper/face regions.

Contact-sheet archive context overlaps the baseline open dossier and four photographic exposures. Non-legible margins add no requested text requirement; a new illegibility instruction would be unwarranted. Retain the actual sheet as authorial staging, with no claimed new contribution.

Splash requires an impacting object, raised liquid sheet and detached drops connected at a contact zone. Surface wetness outside is not splash evidence. Adding the complete event would shift the shutter toward water impact and distract from comparison; do not substitute rain or decorative droplets.

Crisp subject, recognizable middle distance and lower detail farther away are already expressed by moderate depth of field keeping sheet grid and courtyard gate recognizable. No distinct change is supplied; the baseline depth decision is preserved independently.

Environmental portrait source explicitly includes an adult subject and functional task/place. The current reference establishes no age fact. The already-authored observer/file/window relation remains generic authorial staging; source cannot supply adulthood or professional role.

The hanok profile requires bounded madang, raised maru level, eaves/column junction, room-maru-courtyard sightline and daily transition action together. A generic courtyard window supplies none of that full topology. Adding it would replace the records-room architecture and task with a different culturally specific composition; no native selection.

The aperture source includes a freestanding opening, continuous rim, near ground and different far space. The existing attached room window is not that complete freestanding gate. A generic sill boundary is independently authored; no portal or instance claim follows and whole source is declined.

Distant thunder-cloud illumination needs a cloud bank with a faint illuminated patch beyond a dark foreground. The view is an enclosed courtyard rather than a far horizon; introducing a horizon and flash would shift the scene outside and reduce the paper/current-space comparison.

The mixed-source/environment-focus/architecture bundle includes source-bound color zones, recognizable focus planes and a recessed doorway/path/service-fixture relation together. Baseline warm/cool light and focus overlap two elements but not the doorway/service-fixture component. Partial bundle adoption is declined; isolated generic light choices already have independent reasons.

The occluded doorway-view source explicitly places a separately visible adult in an observed room. Adulthood is not frozen and the perspective would change the viewer into a partly hidden observer. ALT_FRAME considers only independently justified generic framing, without adopting the age-bearing source or claiming voyeurism/consent.

A partly obstructed observer frame is a compatible generic composition in ALT_FRAME. Its foreground obstruction supports limited viewpoint but makes the sheet/contact/window endpoints less readable. Baseline favors simultaneous visibility without an extra edge covering content.

Thick aperture, near-window activity and receding room can support ALT_FRAME-like framing, but the baseline already gives sill/wall thickness and near-window task while prioritizing the actual courtyard as deeper plane. Rotating toward receding room would trade away outside comparison area; retain baseline.

The private-room soft-window profile requires an unmistakably adult actor, bedroom/hotel/dressing-room cues, curtained diffusion, self-directed room/grooming action and a material edge relation. The records task and reference age do not supply those. Ordinary window light does not activate this complete profile.

A near table edge between camera and seated person is already implied by the diagonal view from the table corner and foreground dossier. Explicitly thickening that edge would obscure the file. It supplies no distinct retained contribution beyond existing independent geometry.

The welcoming map/dice/sheets room requires primary TTRPG practice and shared participants. Those owners and practice are absent. Records and sheets do not supply that primary context; decline rather than import extra participants or dice.

The rescue-boat deck source requires line path, water target and boat-side recovery endpoint. Courtyard wetness is unrelated. This would replace setting and central activity, giving no compatible local records-room refinement.

The body-region tool contact requires a held tool contacting its own operator body region, with hand/tool/body ownership traced together. Photographic paper contact supplies none of that mechanism. Reject rather than relabel fingertips touching paper as bodily tool contact.

New espfull_skin_beads specifies separate moisture beads/specular points and intervening temple skin. The protected reference does not require that surface state. It is optional, native_approval=false/not qualified, and adding beads would create a separate bodily detail without strengthening record-versus-current-space legibility. No entire cue is adopted or renamed generic. New source pixels remain unscored.

Public presentation/arrival source requires presenter artifact and several audience responses plus primary public-recognition context. One private observer and file are not that event. Importing audience would change subject count and scene purpose rather than clarify the test.

The body/environment growth connection requires a fictional body endpoint and environmental growth with a continuous path. Neither owner nor path is present. A room-to-courtyard sightline is not an organic connection; source cannot be partially borrowed as metaphor.

The VRMMO maintenance action requires emergency logout/account recovery/patch restore systems and a primary maintenance scene. A paper dossier is not those system records; no complete source use or factual account claim.

The sect formation infrastructure test requires primary xianxia formation-repair context and a before-breakthrough event. Those context and temporal facts are absent; a quiet information comparison is not a test of protective infrastructure.

Urban archivist would assign a specific professional subject role not supplied by the portrait or request. Handling records remains an observable authorial activity; discovery cannot establish profession. Keep the observer subject instead of adopting the role source.

The modern reinterpretation profile requires jeogori-derived closure/tailored separates, window gradient, lace/matte cloth/polished wood contrast and restrained warm grade together. Current cardigan/shirt contains none of its closure/lace meaning. Full wardrobe/style rewrite is outside the restrained comparative benefit and native profile is unselected.

Window-to-room light gradient is a compatible generic craft alternative developed as ALT_DAYLIGHT. Removing the desk lamp simplifies sources, but loses the warm paper/cool actual-space separation that helps this particular representation comparison. Baseline wins on medium boundaries and mood; full profile is not selected.

A low-detail field ahead of the gaze would require simplifying the visible exterior into negative space. That competes directly with the gate/crossbar as comparison target. The source fragment alone omits a grounded vector owner, so no entire cue is adopted; baseline keeps a recognizable target.

The grain/architectural-connectivity/exposure bundle requires all three components, including doorway path and service-fixture connection. Grain alone is no substitute. Adding fixtures and a doorway would clutter the window comparison; do not adopt a partial style bundle.

Chin cradle requires thumb under chin, index on cheek, same elbow on desk and continuous hand/arm/head. ALT_TEMPLE is a different generic gesture, not this source. A complete cradle could be staged but would cover reference features and add an unneeded second support task; no retained change.

The common-plane scale relation requires an existing miniature artifact with recognizable small structural features and a familiar-size reference at the same depth. A photographic depiction of a gate is not a physical miniature artifact. Discovery supplies neither owner; decline.
